entities.summary: Justin Ross "J. R." Sweezy is an American former professional football player who was a guard in the National Football League (NFL). He was selected by the Seattle Seahawks in the seventh round, 225th overall, of the 2012 NFL draft. He played college football for the NC State Wolfpack.
